[TODO:fr] The elders ask many questions.

silent_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Truth lives within you.
Let it be heard.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Your soft voice fills the room.

boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Wisdom is not for boasting.

reunion.text:
[TODO:fr] She weeps:
"Why have you done this to us?"

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] She holds the words in her heart.
[TODO:fr] Do not run from her love.

blame_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] She is your mother.
Answer her with grace.

shame_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Stay With Her
shame_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] She has searched three days.
Give her the truth.

return.text:
